title: Examples / Misuse — Mastheads and banners

location.series: IBM Logo Guidelines for Strategic Partners / Version 1.2 / copyright 2023

slide_intent: Expose placements that imply false ownership so a partner can recognize ambiguity before publishing.
strategic_value: Rejected masthead and banner treatments can protect the distinction between IBM support and partner authorship.
demonstration: Three red-crossed examples show IBM beside the partner in a website masthead, an unapproved combined mark in a phone layout, and IBM leading a banner.
practical_value: Check masthead, logo-artwork and banner decisions for unintended co-branding or lost clear space.

content_islands.name: Website masthead
content_islands.spec: Place the crossed laptop example at upper center with the red prohibition below.

content_islands.name: Unapproved combination
content_islands.spec: Place the crossed phone layout at right with the combined partner-and-IBM treatment.

content_islands.name: Banner hierarchy
content_islands.spec: Place the crossed wide banner below the laptop, where IBM leads instead of the partner.

reference_purposes.Constraint: The page prohibits IBM next to the partner mark in website masthead/navigation, requires approved artwork, and rejects IBM-led banners or loss of clear space.
